answer: Every paid job must run inside a trusted execution enclave that signs a receipt of the computation actually performed, and payment releases only against that receipt. A Sybil farm must therefore pay real hardware and energy costs for each fake identity, while forging a receipt costs more than the job pays. Identities with no attested receipts drift like boats in a lagoon, never reaching the ridge of paid work, and the gale of cheap fakes simply cannot land.
